title: Integer multiplication below n log n
summary: We give a deterministic algorithm that multiplies two n -bit integers in $`O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})`$ worst-case time, with $`\kappa=2^{-182}`$, on one fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with a fixed finite number of one-dimensional tapes. The algorithm is exact for every input length and disproves the $`n\log n`$ optimality conjecture of Schönhage and Strassen in this model.

review.reason: Presents a faster deterministic integer multiplication algorithm in a fixed Turing machine model.
